subject: sociology

moments.title: The Gutenberg Galaxy
moments.body: McLuhan analyses the transition from oral to print culture and predicts an electronic 'global village'.
moments.takeaway: Media shape cognition and social organisation.

moments.title: Understanding Media
moments.body: McLuhan's aphoristic book introduces 'the medium is the message' and the distinction between hot and cool media.
moments.takeaway: Form of media is more important than content.

moments.title: The Global Village
moments.body: Co-authored with Bruce Powers and published after McLuhan's death, the book restates his thesis for the early internet era.
moments.takeaway: Theorists' frames sometimes anticipate technologies they did not see.

now.title: McLuhan online
now.body: Digital sociology revisits McLuhan as platforms reshape attention, news and politics.
now.open_questions: Are platforms a new 'hot' medium or do they require new categories?

reflection: McLuhan's reputation has cycled in and out of academic respectability since the 1960s.
